competences.description: Attacks with magical powers and inflicts continuous damage for 2 turns with a 50% chance. The damage increases according to Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times with magic and weakens the Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance for each attack. The damage increases according to the Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: After attacking, steals one beneficial effect from the target and applies it to all allies, and absorbs the Attack Bar by 20%. Also increases your Attack Power by 30% for each beneficial effect you are granted with, and increases your Attack Speed by 5 for each beneficial effect granted on the allies, up to 100. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Remove a beneficial effect and take it for yourself
effets.note: Applies buff AOE to all allies

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be increased by 30%.
Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
effets.note: After stealing the enemy's beneficial effect
